title: /clear docs dont mention that it clears context

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report correctly identifies an omission in the documentation for the /clear command in docs/reference/commands.md, which states that /clear only clears the visual terminal display when in fact it also resets the agent conversation context and starts a new session.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Updating documentation in docs/reference/commands.md is a trivial text change (documentation & strings).

summary.problem: The documentation for /clear in docs/reference/commands.md incorrectly states that it only clears the terminal display, failing to mention that it also clears the agent context and starts a new session.
summary.root_cause: The command documentation in docs/reference/commands.md was not updated when /clear was implemented with context resetting functionality (via geminiClient.resetChat()).
summary.context: In packages/cli/src/ui/commands/clearCommand.ts, executing /clear triggers geminiClient.resetChat() to clear the agent's active conversation history and context, resets session state, and fires session lifecycle hooks before clearing the UI terminal screen.

steps: Update the /clear section in docs/reference/commands.md to state that it clears the agent conversation context and starts a new session, in addition to clearing the visible terminal screen.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The /clear documentation in docs/reference/commands.md clearly describes both the visual terminal clearing and the reset of the agent's conversation context.
verification_steps: Review docs/reference/commands.md to confirm that the description for /clear explicitly notes that agent conversation context is cleared and a new session is started.
